buffer_geometry_particles.name: Buffer Geometry Particles
buffer_geometry_particles.description: Particle system using buffer geometry for GPU-driven particle effects.

dynamic_cubemap.name: Dynamic Cubemap
dynamic_cubemap.description: Real-time dynamic cubemap rendering for reflections and environment mapping.

materials_transmission.name: Materials Transmission
materials_transmission.description: Demonstrates material transmission and translucency shader effects.

tiles_explained.name: Tiles Explained
tiles_explained.description: Visual explanation of tile-based shader patterns and tiling techniques.

degrading_shader_demo.name: Degrading Shader Demo
degrading_shader_demo.description: Demonstrates shader degradation effects over time or with parameters.

queer_collection_gallery_a.name: Queer Collection Gallery A
queer_collection_gallery_a.description: Gallery display of queer-themed shader collection artworks.

shader_gallery.name: Shader Gallery
shader_gallery.description: Main gallery showcasing various shader techniques and effects.

shader_01_shaping.name: Shader 01 — Shaping Functions
shader_01_shaping.description: Book of Shaders chapter on shaping functions and mathematical curves.

shader_02_colors.name: Shader 02 — Colors
shader_02_colors.description: Book of Shaders chapter on color mixing and color spaces.

shader_03_shapes.name: Shader 03 — Shapes
shader_03_shapes.description: Book of Shaders chapter on drawing shapes with distance fields.

shader_04_matrices.name: Shader 04 — Matrices
shader_04_matrices.description: Book of Shaders chapter on matrix transformations in 2D.

shader_05_patterns.name: Shader 05 — Patterns
shader_05_patterns.description: Book of Shaders chapter on repeating patterns and tessellation.

shader_06_random.name: Shader 06 — Random
shader_06_random.description: Book of Shaders chapter on randomness and hash functions in shaders.

shader_07_noise.name: Shader 07 — Noise
shader_07_noise.description: Book of Shaders chapter on Perlin noise and gradient noise.

shader_08_cellularnoise.name: Shader 08 — Cellular Noise
shader_08_cellularnoise.description: Book of Shaders chapter on Voronoi and cellular noise patterns.

shader_09_fbm.name: Shader 09 — Fractal Brownian Motion
shader_09_fbm.description: Book of Shaders chapter on fractal Brownian motion and layered noise.

shader_10_reactiondiffusion.name: Shader 10 — Reaction Diffusion
shader_10_reactiondiffusion.description: Book of Shaders chapter on reaction-diffusion systems and Turing patterns.

shader_11_queerrubber.name: Shader 11 — Queer Rubber
shader_11_queerrubber.description: Book of Shaders chapter exploring queer rubber material aesthetics.

shader_12_pinkextravaganza.name: Shader 12 — Pink Extravaganza
shader_12_pinkextravaganza.description: Book of Shaders chapter with vibrant pink shader extravaganza effects.

cove_display.name: Cove Display
cove_display.description: Cyclorama/infinity cove surface — curved floor-to-wall form built with SurfaceTool. Accepts any shader via grid config. Continuous UV mapping for seamless tiling.

pixel_carpet_gallery.name: Pixel Carpet Gallery
pixel_carpet_gallery.description: 30m corridor with 69 procedural carpet panels on floor, walls, and ceiling. Art to Eat-inspired installation using wallpaper_tile shader with 17 groups and 10 neon palettes.

carpet_cove_gallery.name: Carpet Cove Gallery
carpet_cove_gallery.description: Grid-based gallery of 24 cyclorama cove displays with wallpaper patterns. Coves in facing rows with 3m aisle, each showing a unique pattern on curved surfaces.

wall_cove.name: Wall Cove
wall_cove.description: Half-cove slope artifact — curved floor-to-wall transition built with SurfaceTool. High-res quarter-circle curve with continuous UVs for shader tiling. Place at wall base for smooth architectural transition.

wall_pattern_colorizer.name: Wall Pattern Colorizer
wall_pattern_colorizer.description: Colors wall cubes in the GridSystem MultiMesh using wallpaper group tiling math. Each wall cube becomes a pixel in the pattern. Uses per-instance colors like GridColorizer.

wall_shader_showcase.name: Wall Shader Showcase
wall_shader_showcase.description: Replaces GridMultiMesh material with GPU shaders from the shader library. Cycles through different shaders on wall cubes — voronoi, tartan, rothko, truchet, etc.

shader_arch_gallery.name: Shader Arch Gallery
shader_arch_gallery.description: A barrel-vault arch tunnel where each section has a different GPU shader. Walk through to see 20 shaders on curved walls, ceiling, and floor.

wall_pattern_gallery.name: Wall Pattern Gallery
wall_pattern_gallery.description: Overlays wallpaper group shader patterns on grid wall cubes in clusters. Like the catalyst chromatic mode but with all 17 wallpaper groups as GPU shaders.

pattern_compositor.name: Pattern Compositor
pattern_compositor.description: Zone-based pattern composition using the SpatialComposition library. Presets: carpet (border/field/medallion), facade (base/columns/windows/cornice), mosaic, quilt, tunnel. Each zone gets a different wallpaper group shader.
